column1: # Safety audit of a Claude-only draft: a QA record, not the council's back-translation.

column3: 'Incarcator nepotrivit' reads as 'unsuitable charger', an invented claim that the charger is wrong; the English only says live power does not match the selected charger's saved charges.
'ora fixa' can read as 'a fixed/set time', losing the whole-hour constraint, so a rider on these models may pick a time like 14:30 and be refused again.
